title: Developer dashboard semantic regression demo
description: A controlled before/after pair with one cosmetic change and two user-facing regressions.

ground_truth.summary: Dashboard card shadows are slightly softer and more diffuse.
ground_truth.evidence: Card geometry, text, values, and interactions are unchanged.

ground_truth.summary: The Chinese CTA label is clipped inside its unchanged button bounds.
ground_truth.user_impact: The primary action is no longer legible to zh-CN users.
ground_truth.evidence: Baseline reads ‘查看完整报告’; candidate exposes only a clipped fragment.

ground_truth.summary: The refresh glyph disappears while its empty button hit target remains.
ground_truth.user_impact: Users cannot discover the refresh action visually.
ground_truth.evidence: The circular arrow is visible in baseline and absent in candidate.

evaluation.notes: The broad shadow region is intentionally excluded from strict localization scoring.
